projectDescription: Advanced RAG pipeline optimization framework that uses DSPy to automate prompt tuning and few-shot selection with MIPRO, COPRO, SIMBA, GEPA, and BootstrapFewShot optimizers across multiple QA datasets backed by Weaviate hybrid search.
keyFeatures: 5-stage modular RAG pipeline: Query Rewriting, Sub-Query Generation, Metadata Extraction, Hybrid Retrieval, Chain-of-Thought Answer Generation
5 DSPy optimizers: MIPROv2, COPRO, BootstrapFewShotWithRandomSearch, SIMBA, and GEPA
Weaviate hybrid search combining vector similarity and keyword filtering with structured metadata
DeepEval integration for 5 RAG metrics: Answer Relevancy, Faithfulness, Contextual Precision, Contextual Recall, Contextual Relevancy
YAML-driven configuration for all pipeline, model, and optimizer hyperparameters
5 benchmark datasets: FreshQA, HotpotQA, PubMedQA, TriviaQA, Wikipedia
Confident AI tracing and logging for optimization and evaluation runs
Extensible architecture for adding new datasets following the established pattern
publicApiSurface: QueryRewriter(use_chain_of_thought: bool = True) — dspy.Module for query optimization
SubQueryGenerator(min_subqueries: int = 2, max_subqueries: int = 5) — dspy.Module for query decomposition
SubQueryGenerator.forward(query: str, num_subqueries: Optional[int] = None) -> dspy.Prediction
MetadataExtractor(extractor_llm: dspy.LM) — dspy.Module for structured metadata extraction
MetadataExtractor.forward(text: str, schema: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]
WeaviateRetriever(weaviate_url, weaviate_api_key, collection_name, top_k, metadata_schema) — dspy.Module for hybrid search
FreshQARAG / HotpotQARAG / PubMedQARAG / TriviaQARAG / WikipediaRAG — dataset pipeline classes
freshqa_rag_mipro.py / freshqa_rag_copro.py / freshqa_rag_simba.py / freshqa_rag_gepa.py / freshqa_rag_bootstrap_few_shot.py — optimizer scripts
